acceptanceCriteria: work-item new and preflight fail closed on MIGRATION_REQUIRED and INCOMPATIBLE without writes; observe/status/compatibility/migrate plan/doctor remain available; CLI and MCP semantics agree; regression tests pass
goal: An incompatible repository cannot receive a new Work Item or governance decision, while read-only diagnostics and reviewed migration planning remain available.
intent: Enforce compatibility boundaries before governance execution and formalize the migration hardening contract.
outOfScope: Raw Request Binding;Requested Operation;Capability Mapping;Outcome projection;schema 3 migration implementation;release publication
